name: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure
summary: 放置类猫咪 RPG。开发者披露 AI 用于部分曲目的初版生成（随后人工编辑并改造成可循环版本）以及商店页简介的草拟与修改，并明确称视觉美术未使用生成式 AI。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: No generative AI was used to create the game's visual art or artwork. Generative AI was used to create the initial versions of some music tracks, which were then manually edited and adapted into loopable versions for use in the game. AI was also used to assist with drafting and editing some store page descriptions.

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 StandinFire Studio）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 38），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 2 篇原始来源（GameDB.ai 对本作 Steam AI 披露的结构化索引页、AI Transparency Index 逐字复刻商店披露的分析页）。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
disclosureQuote: No generative AI was used to create the game's visual art or artwork. Generative AI was used to create the initial versions of some music tracks, which were then manually edited and adapted into loopable versions for use in the game. AI was also used to assist with drafting and editing some store page descriptions.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-10-31 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: An idle cat RPG. The developer states generative AI produced the initial versions of some music tracks, which were then manually edited into loopable versions, and that AI also helped draft and edit store page descriptions, while no generative AI was used for the game's visual art.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer StandinFire Studio) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 38); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 2 raw source(s) were read. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit.
